entities.name: Adopt Effect Schema at the public snapshot boundary
entities.summary: Replace parallel handwritten Control Room snapshot guards with one authoritative strict Effect Schema while preserving public bytes, content identity, cache custody, errors, and UI behavior.

acceptance: Producer and browser share one authoritative public snapshot Schema
Closed values reject excess properties at every nesting level
Exact whole-second UTC and Gregorian calendar validity remain unchanged
Unique identities, relation endpoints, safe integers, enums, patterns, and filename binding remain enforced
Canonical public bytes, SHA-256, cross-document binding, and cache re-verification remain PBK-owned and unchanged
Boolean guard APIs, candidate classifications, freshness, rollback, fetch, and XState behavior remain stable

relations.summary: The migration preserves the accepted public snapshot, last-known-valid cache, and Control Room state boundary.
The public exporter exposes the authoritative representation Schema consumed by the browser.
